products.name: fanta
products.description: A plastic bottle of Fanta orange flavoured carbonated soft drink, filled with bright orange liquid and featuring the Fanta brand label with green leaf logo on an orange-tinted body and blue cap

products.name: t-shirt
products.description: Olive green short-sleeve crew neck T-shirt with a large front print divided into two panels. The upper panel shows two birds in flight above the word 'GROW'; the lower panel features stylized clover/plant illustrations in a minimalist green and white design.

products.name: denim jeans blue
products.description: Loose-fitting wide-leg jeans with a high-rise waist, button fly, decorative topstitching and fading and a relaxed, flowy silhouette.

products.name: Kurta Pajama
products.description: A men's traditional knee-length kurta with a mandarin band collar, front button placket, full-length sleeves with a relaxed fit, subtle white vertical pinstripes, and a small chest pocket. The relaxed silhouette is shown paired with white trousers.

products.name: Salwar Kameez
products.description: Elegant floor-length traditional ensemble featuring a long kameez with intricate gold-toned embroidery and embellished motifs along the front panel, sleeves and hem, paired with matching tapered trousers and a lightweight embroidered dupatta draped over the shoulder. The set has a feminine silhouette with detailed craftsmanship and a flowing drape, styled with embellished footwear by a pool-side setting.
